method: Actual triangle vertex heights decomposed by subtracting retained known host+mantle-only vertex profile, then barycentric interpolation of resulting physical core contribution. This distinguishes the physical ridge from face-centroid material assignment. Exact authored triangle barycentric cross-sections, 10um step; known quiet-host sinusoid subtracted only to separate relief from host warp. 5um support threshold is measurement convention, not acceptance tolerance. Full material face-vertex envelopes include endcaps and polygon boundaries, not merely config radii.
